title: THE STASH HELP LINES ARE READABLE
why: Found by the 4K menu text scan of 2026-10-08: once the stash filter tabs and key row grew (v19.76, v19.77), the help line under the grid (hover and press J to tag junk), the sell notes and the FREEBIE KIT bar were the smallest print left in any menu, at 11 pixels. They are 13 now; every line has room.
now: The help lines and the FREEBIE KIT bar on the stash are easier to read.

edits.anchor:
.fkbox b{ color:var(--amber); letter-spacing:.1em; font-size:11px; }
  .fkbox span{ flex:1; color:var(--ash); font-size:11px; }
